title: How he got the name Jim Little
summary: His grandfather George Robinson called Jim Robinson Jim Crow and Brown Jim Little to tell the two apart.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit more, first of all, that nickname Jim Little, how did you get that name? Who gave that name?

Oh, well Jim and I got that name together. See, my grandpa, he named Jim Crow. And me, Jim Little. And see, they had two Jims around the house. And he had to make a difference. And he got one crow and one little.
Well, how did you get the name Jim? What's the name? How did they get the name of Jim? How did you get the name of Jim? Well, I don't know.

I don't know how I got the name of Jim, but I was in two different houses, you know. Because I used to live with my mother and my stepdad. And Jim was with his, my grandmother was dead. Jim would live with his other sister and her husband, see. And my grandpa, George Robinson, well, he named Jim Crow. And he said, well, I'm going to make a difference between other Jims. I'll call him Jim Little. Yeah. That's how that was. And, well, that's about the best I can do for you, Bill.
